rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for the nighttime of the current day.

example.english: Shall we go see a movie tonight?
example.traditional: 今晚我哋去睇戲，好唔好？
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 hei3 hou2 m4 hou2
